title: Finance team delivers strong returns for communities
summary: Nearly 200 Clorox Finance teammates volunteered across seven regions, contributing nearly 1,000 service hours to support local communities through Every Hour Counts.
body_markdown:
The experience was meaningful not only for the communities served, but also powerful for the teammates who took part.


*“The Finance function is full of dedicated, high-performing professionals who are passionate about their work. This activation gave us a chance to step away from our day-to-day responsibilities and see one another beyond our daily roles. It was a reminder that behind the work are people with shared values, unique experiences, and a genuine desire to make a difference.”* – Leah Hodges


*“Thank you for putting this event together. It was incredibly rewarding to spend time with my team at the Food Bank and give back directly to our community. Stepping away from our everyday routine to support such an important cause together made the impact feel even more meaningful.”* – Karen Reyes


*“Participating in this activity was a highly rewarding experience…it strengthened collaboration and teamwork by bringing together colleagues from different areas to achieve a common goal. The experience benefited the community while reinforcing a sense of belonging, commitment, and pride in being part of a socially responsible company..””* – Brenda Natalie Morales
